faqs.question: What is the difference between Primo Fluted and ordinary flat PVC wall panels?
faqs.answer: While flat panels create a smooth surface, Primo Fluted panels feature 3D vertical ribs with a dramatic 17mm flute depth and 24mm pitch. This creates high-contrast architectural shadow lines under linear cove lighting, adding physical depth, texture, and acoustic sound diffusion to modern interiors.

faqs.question: What is the wholesale price of fluted wall panels in Gurgaon per panel and per sq.ft?
faqs.answer: Primo Fluted panels are priced at ₹599 per panel wholesale (MRP ₹1,290, 57% off). Each 9.5 ft × 6.3 in panel covers 5.2 sq.ft, resulting in an effective rate of ₹115 to ₹130 per sq.ft. Professional installation across Gurugram typically costs an additional ₹20 to ₹35 per sq.ft.

faqs.question: Are Primo Fluted panels recommended for living room TV accent walls and media consoles?
faqs.answer: Yes, fluted louvers are currently the #1 architectural trend for living room TV backdrops in Gurgaon. The deep vertical grooves allow for concealed routing of television cables and power wires, and provide dedicated channels for embedding continuous LED neon flex strip lighting for a floating glow effect.

faqs.question: How do I clean and dust fluted wall panels with deep vertical grooves?
faqs.answer: Cleaning fluted panels is effortless. Because of the anti-static Diamond Shield finish, dust does not easily stick to the surface. Simply run a feather duster or soft vacuum brush attachment down the vertical grooves once a month, or wipe with a damp microfiber cloth for deeper cleaning.

faqs.question: Do Primo Fluted panels reduce room echo and television sound reverberation?
faqs.answer: Yes. The alternating concave-convex flute geometry scatters high-frequency sound reflections, reducing ambient flutter echo and room reverberation by approximately 28%. This noticeably enhances speech clarity for home theatres, video calls, and living room acoustics.

faqs.question: Can Primo Fluted panels withstand Delhi NCR monsoon humidity and wall dampness?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Engineered with a heavy composite matrix with 0.0% moisture uptake, Primo Fluted panels will never swell, soften, or rot even when mounted against exterior damp walls or during high-humidity monsoons in Delhi NCR.

faqs.question: How many fluted finishes are available in the Primo collection?
faqs.answer: Primo Fluted comes in 13 exclusive catalog finishes (FP-701 to FP-713), covering warm Scandinavian oaks, rich smoked walnuts, modern charcoal grey wood tones, and natural teak textures with tactile wood-pore embossing.

faqs.question: Can Primo Fluted louvers be combined with Primo Plain panels in the same room?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many Gurgaon architects pair 12-inch Primo Plain panels on surrounding walls with 17mm Primo Fluted panels on the central bed backdrop or TV console wall. Both share compatible interlocking heights (9.5 ft floor-to-ceiling) for cohesive luxury styling.

faqs.question: What tools and fasteners are needed for fluted panel installation in Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: Installation uses concealed stainless steel starter clips and brad nails driven through the interlocking flange, or high-tack hybrid polymer adhesive applied to the reverse. Planks interlock seamlessly without visible screw heads or nails on the decorative flute face.

faqs.question: Can I inspect physical samples of Primo Fluted panels in Gurgaon before placing an order?
faqs.answer: Yes! You can visit the Goals Floors warehouse in Gurugram or request our architectural swatch sample kit delivered directly to your doorstep in Gurgaon, Noida, or South Delhi within 24 hours to feel the texture, weight, and finish under your home's lighting.
